usage: SortVcf.py [-h] --output_fn OUTPUT_FN [--input_dir INPUT_DIR]
                  [--vcf_fn_prefix VCF_FN_PREFIX]
                  [--vcf_fn_suffix VCF_FN_SUFFIX] [--ref_fn REF_FN]
                  [--sampleName SAMPLENAME] [--contigs_fn CONTIGS_FN]
                  [--cmd_fn CMD_FN] [--pileup_only PILEUP_ONLY]
                  [--print_ref_calls PRINT_REF_CALLS]
                  [--check_malformed_records CHECK_MALFORMED_RECORDS]
                  [--haploid_precise HAPLOID_PRECISE]
                  [--haploid_sensitive HAPLOID_SENSITIVE] [--qual QUAL]
                  [--output_all_contigs_in_gvcf_header OUTPUT_ALL_CONTIGS_IN_GVCF_HEADER]
                  [--use_gpu USE_GPU]

Sort a VCF file according to contig name and starting position

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output_fn OUTPUT_FN
                        Output VCF filename, required
  --input_dir INPUT_DIR
                        Input directory
  --vcf_fn_prefix VCF_FN_PREFIX
                        Input vcf filename prefix
  --vcf_fn_suffix VCF_FN_SUFFIX
                        Input vcf filename suffix
  --ref_fn REF_FN       Reference fasta file input
  --sampleName SAMPLENAME
                        Define the sample name to be shown in the VCF file,
                        optional
  --contigs_fn CONTIGS_FN
                        Contigs file with all processing contigs
  --cmd_fn CMD_FN       If defined, added command line into VCF header
  --pileup_only PILEUP_ONLY
                        Use the pileup model only when calling, default:
                        disable
  --print_ref_calls PRINT_REF_CALLS
                        Show reference calls (0/0) in vcf file output
  --check_malformed_records CHECK_MALFORMED_RECORDS
                        Check the malformed records in vcf file, default:
                        enable
  --haploid_precise HAPLOID_PRECISE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable haploid calling mode. Only 1/1 is
                        considered as a variant
  --haploid_sensitive HAPLOID_SENSITIVE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable haploid calling mode. 0/1 and 1/1
                        are considered as a variant
  --qual QUAL           If set, variants with >$qual will be marked 'PASS', or
                        'LowQual' otherwise, optional
  --output_all_contigs_in_gvcf_header OUTPUT_ALL_CONTIGS_IN_GVCF_HEADER
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable output all contigs in gvcf
                        header. Default: disable
  --use_gpu USE_GPU     Use GPU for variant calling. Default: disable
